name: TuneBrew
purpose: Real-time vocal pitch correction. Natural mode tunes tightly while keeping vibrato, slides and held-note life; Classic mode is the hard-tune robot effect.
avoid_for: anything that is not a single clean voice
vocals with bleed or backing vocals in the same track

latency.note: About 49 ms at 48 kHz (set by the lowest trackable pitch, 70 Hz), reported to the host. Too much for tracking.

params.name: Key
params.ai_hint: The song's key, as told by the user. Ignored when scale is Chromatic.

params.name: Scale
params.ai_hint: Use Chromatic (nearest semitone) unless the user has told you the key; never guess a key.

params.name: Mode
params.ai_hint: Natural: human-sounding tuning. Classic: plain hard-tune for the robot / T-Pain effect (with retune 0).

params.name: Retune
params.ai_hint: 0 = instant. 10-30 tight pop. 40-80 soft and transparent. In Natural mode 0 is still human; in Classic 0 is the robot effect.

params.name: Amount
params.ai_hint: How far to pull towards the target note. 100 is full correction; 70-85 is a gentle touch-up.

params.name: Vibrato
params.ai_hint: Natural mode. How much of the singer's own vibrato to keep: 100 untouched, 0 flattened.

params.name: Flex
params.ai_hint: Natural mode. Higher lets deliberate bends and blue notes pass uncorrected; 0 corrects everything.

params.name: Humanize
params.ai_hint: Natural mode. Higher corrects long held notes more gently; 0 keeps everything tight.

params.name: Transition
params.ai_hint: Natural mode. Lets note attacks, scoops and slides through for this long; 20 tight, 40-60 natural.

params.name: Transpose
params.ai_hint: Shift in semitones with formants kept. Leave at 0 unless asked.

params.name: Ref A4
params.ai_hint: Tuning reference. Leave at 440 unless the user gives another.

params.name: Mix
params.ai_hint: Dry/wet. Keep at 100; blending dry with tuned vocal causes chorusing.

notes: Written against TuneBrew 1.4.3 (TuneParams.hpp, TuneBrewPlugin.cpp). The upstream Detect Key button, output gain and meters are not exposed: Plugsalot has no key-detection UI yet, so the key comes from the user.
Put it first in the chain, before EQ, compression and effects.
CPU: 2.06% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, rounded up.
